Package threepl.procs

Class InputProc

java.lang.Object
threepl.procs.InbuiltProc
threepl.procs.InputProc
All Implemented Interfaces:
TDEConstants, Constant
public class InputProc extends InbuiltProc implements Constant, TDEConstants
An inbuilt procedure to create an input mode variable. This has two or more input arguments and no output arguments. The 1st input argument is the variable identifier. The 2nd input argument is the type or type string.

Each of the optional following arguments can be -

  • an attributes map
  • a key=value argument

  • Method Details

    • execute

      public ArrayList<Var> execute(NodeList inargs, NodeList outargs, ArrayList<String> names, RefOrVal par_arg, int[] dim_des, boolean is_input, boolean is_output)
      s Execute the procedure input(). This does not generate in-line executable code.
      Overrides:
      execute in class InbuiltProc
      Parameters:
      inargs - is a list of input argument tree nodes
      outargs - is a list of output argument tree nodes
      names - is a list of identifiers evaluated via method getIdents() prior to calling execute()
      par_arg - is an argument that has been passed to a parameter and is used to get the parameter type if none is declared
      dim_des - is a dimensional description for a compound constant argument or is null - it must be null here!
      is_input - is true if this variable is the input parameter for a module, procedure or function
      is_output - is true if this variable is the output parameter for a module or procedure
      Returns:
      list containing the variable(s)
